title: A Witness for the Portrait
author: B. M. Yarrow
blurb: Ulyana Underhill, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
